purpose: Final Stage 5-1 gate for the canonical 267-Hero bond/fetter block.

conditionType1.canonicalValidation: Parm1 equals the owning canonical Hero for all Type1 rows; source Parm2 thresholds are preserved verbatim.

conditionType2.missionStageJoin: When MissionInfo.MissionType == 5 and MissionInfo.Param2 == 6, MissionInfo.Param3 -> ConfigDataHeroDungeonLevelInfo.ID; stage ownership is derived by reverse-indexing ConfigDataHeroInformationInfo.DungeonLevels_ID[].
conditionType2.candidateResolver: canonical(MissionInfo.Param1) UNION canonical(HeroInformationInfo.ID that reverse-owns MissionInfo.Param3 via DungeonLevels_ID[]) MINUS FetterOwnerHeroId
conditionType2.requiredHeroResolver: the sole remaining canonical Hero candidate
conditionType2.importantOrientationRule: MissionInfo.Param1 is not always the required Hero and the Param3 stage owner is not always the required Hero; either side can be the Fetter owner. Resolve by set subtraction against the Fetter owner.
conditionType2.otherCanonicalType2Rows: MissionType 5/Param2 2 or 5, MissionType 29, and MissionType 34 do not produce an external required-Hero edge in the verified canonical scope.

decision: Hero Stage 5-1 is complete. The canonical 267-Hero bond block has five source fetters per Hero, all CompletionCondition types are semantically resolved, and all required-Hero joins are unambiguous.
